entities.name: Invasion of Banu Qurayza
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Siege of Banu Qurayza was a military siege undertaken by the early Muslims against the fortress of Banu Qurayza, an Arabian Jewish tribe, in January 627. It followed on from the Battle of the Trench.
